name: Price lists
description: Price lists by currency, segment or company with validity periods and quantity tiers, product bundles and the maximum discount per role

list.title: Price lists
list.description: Prices by currency, segment or company, with validity periods. A quote uses the company list, then the segment list and finally the default of the currency.
list.emptyHint: Create a list to have prices other than the catalog's by currency, segment or customer.

form.description: Set the currency, who the list applies to and when it is in effect. Product prices are entered on the list page.
form.name: Name
form.segmentHint: Applies to the organizations in the segment when the quote is made.
form.companiesHint: A list for a specific company takes precedence over segment and default lists.
form.validityHint: Leave blank for no limit. Dates are inclusive.
form.defaultHint: Used when no company or segment list applies. Only lists for all organizations can be the default; checking it replaces the previous default.

detail.deleteDescription: The list "{{name}}" and all its prices will be removed. Existing quotes keep the prices they used.

items.title: Prices
items.description: Unit price in {{currency}} per product. Products not in the list use the catalog price.
items.emptyHint: Add products with the price of this list.
items.tiersHint: Each product has one price per quantity tier. The price of the largest tier that does not exceed the quoted quantity applies; the first tier, of 1 unit, is the regular price.
items.invalidPrice: Use a value with up to 2 decimal places.
items.invalidQuantity: Use a number greater than zero with up to 4 decimal places.
items.productRepeated: This product is already in the table. Use another quantity tier on it.
items.quantityRepeated: A tier with this quantity already exists.

limits.title: Maximum discount per role
limits.description: Quotes with a discount above the limit of the owner's role need approval before they are sent.
limits.invalid: Use a percentage between 0 and 100 with up to 2 decimal places.
limits.hint: Leave blank for no limit. Approval follows the "Discount above the limit" policy in Approvals.

errors.price_list_not_found: The price list no longer exists.
errors.price_list_key_taken: Another price list already uses this key.
errors.version_conflict: Someone else changed the list. Reload and try again.
errors.permission_denied: You are not allowed to do this.

bundles.empty: This product is not a bundle
bundles.emptyHint: A bundle groups other products with a fixed price or the sum of its components.
bundles.title: Bundle
bundles.removed: The product is no longer a bundle.
bundles.removeDescription: The components stop being part of this product. The product and the components stay in the catalog.

pricingHint.fixed: The bundle costs the price of the product itself (or the price list's).
pricingHint.sum: The bundle costs the sum of price × quantity of each component. Every component must use the bundle currency.

bundles.formDescription: Choose the products in the bundle and the quantity of each one.
bundles.nestingHint: A bundle cannot contain another bundle, and a product that is already a component cannot become a bundle.
bundles.invalidQuantity: Use a number greater than zero with up to 4 decimal places.

errors.product_bundle_not_found: This product is not a bundle.
errors.product_bundle_nested: This product is a component of another bundle and cannot become a bundle.
errors.price_list_not_found: The price list no longer exists.
errors.version_conflict: Someone else changed the bundle. Reload and try again.
errors.generic: Could not save the bundle. Try again.

placeholders.name: E.g.: Wholesale list
placeholders.description: Describe when to use this list

nav.discountLimitsDescription: Maximum discount each role can give on a quote without approval.
